summary: Retest of the 3 fixes on /config-notificacoes (Templates WhatsApp) reported in iteration_71. All three fixes are confirmed working end-to-end via UI. (1) PREVIEW: eye button (data-testid template-preview-<id>) opens 'Preview do Template' modal with substituted example values — e.g. 'Ola João Silva' instead of raw '{cliente_nome}'. (2) DUPLICAR: new Copy-icon button (data-testid template-duplicate-<id>) calls duplicar API; list grew 7 → 8 with new item 'TesteQA (Cópia)' and toast 'Template Duplicado!' shown; cleanup delete via template-delete-<new_id> works (back to 7). (3) RESTAURAR PADRÃO: clicking button twice keeps total stable at 7 (7 → 7 → 7), no duplication of padrão templates. Notificações regression not re-run (already passing in it.71); no new issues.
critical_code_review_comments: ConfigNotificacoes.js is still ~1100+ lines mixing Notificações + Templates — consider splitting into two components for maintainability (non-blocking).
Backend routes/whatsapp_templates.py: criar/atualizar/duplicar accept body params as query params — works but should adopt Pydantic body model.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted 'TesteQA (Cópia)' during duplicate test — no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 fixes from iteration_71 are verified via UI. Preview substitutes variables; Duplicar creates '<nome> (Cópia)' with toast and works with template-duplicate-<id> testid; Restaurar Padrão is idempotent (delete_many padrao=True before recreate). Total templates stable at 7 (6 default + 1 TesteQA). Note: initial UI count shows 7 rather than the 'expected' 6 default because a non-padrão TesteQA template exists in DB from earlier iterations.
